case.summary: Case HHG-012 was initiated for customer C05876 regarding transaction 3553342 on card C05876-K2 totaling $30.91 on 2016-12-18 04:00:31. The in-person transaction in billing region 494 constituted an out-of-region use pattern, accounting for only 2.3% of the card's 910 historical transactions. Following initial outreach, the customer confirmed that they did not authorize the charge and remain in possession of the physical card. Based on the confirmed unauthorized activity and a calibrated fraud probability of 0.96, the event is classified as fraud.
